footer.brand_desc: Leading platform connecting tutors and students. Search, enroll and manage classes easily and quickly.
footer.newsletter_desc: Subscribe to receive the latest news and updates.
footer.faq_1_a: EduTutor is a leading platform connecting tutors and students. We help you easily find, register and manage online or in-person classes quickly and conveniently.
footer.faq_2_q: How do I create an account?
footer.faq_2_a: You can create an account by clicking the "Sign up" button on the homepage or login page. Enter your email, password and personal information. After signing up, you need to verify your email before logging in.
footer.faq_3_q: How can I register as a tutor?
footer.faq_3_a: To register as a tutor, create an account, then go to "Register as tutor" and fill in your personal information, education, subjects and teaching areas. Your profile will be reviewed by admin within 1-3 days.
footer.faq_4_q: How do I find and enroll in a class?
footer.faq_4_a: On the homepage, you can browse available classes. Use filters by subject, grade, area to find suitable classes. Click on a class for details and click "Register" to submit an enrollment request.
footer.faq_5_q: What is the free trial policy?
footer.faq_5_a: Each class has a free trial period (usually 7 days). During this time, you can attend classes, view lessons and evaluate quality before deciding to officially enroll.
footer.faq_6_a: You can cancel enrollment if you're in the trial period or haven't been approved yet. For approved enrollments, please contact support for refund policy information.
footer.faq_7_a: Currently EduTutor supports bank transfer payments. After transferring, take a photo of the receipt and upload it to the system. Admin will confirm payment within 24 hours.
footer.faq_8_a: Tutors receive a percentage of revenue from each class (usually 70%). Tutors can submit withdrawal requests through the system and admin will process payment to the registered bank account.
footer.faq_9_q: I have a technical issue, who do I contact?
footer.faq_9_a: You can submit a support request through the "Customer Support" section at the bottom of the page. You can also contact us directly via email support@edututor.vn or hotline 0123 456 789 (Mon-Sat, 8:00-21:00).
footer.faq_10_q: How do I rate a tutor?
footer.faq_10_a: After attending a class, you can rate the tutor by going to the class page and selecting the rating section. You can give 1-5 stars and write a review. Ratings help other students choose suitable tutors.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.s1_content: Welcome to EduTutor. By using our platform, you agree to comply with the terms and conditions stated below. Please read carefully before using the service.
s2_items: "User": Anyone who accesses or uses the platform, including Students and Tutors.
"Tutor": A person who registers to provide teaching services on the platform.
"Student": A person who registers to join classes on the platform.
"Service": All features and functions provided by the platform.
terms.s3_content: To fully use the service, you need to register an account with accurate and truthful information. You are responsible for keeping your login credentials secure. All activities under your account will be considered as performed by you.
s4_items: Provide accurate and complete profile information.
Do not request students to pay outside the platform.
Respond to student messages within a reasonable time.
s5_items: Do not share learning materials without permission.
terms.s6_content: Service fees are clearly displayed on each class. EduTutor retains a portion of the service fee as commission. The remainder will be transferred to the tutor as regulated.
terms.s7_content: EduTutor reserves the right to suspend or terminate accounts if users violate the terms of service. Users may request account deletion at any time.
terms.s8_content: EduTutor is a connecting platform and is not directly responsible for the teaching quality of tutors. We make every effort to ensure the best experience for users.
terms.s9_content: EduTutor reserves the right to update terms of service at any time. Users will be notified of important changes via email or platform notifications.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
s1_items: Personal information: Full name, email, phone number, address upon registration.
Learning information: Class enrollment history, attendance, reviews.
Payment information: Transaction history, transfer receipts.
Technical data: IP address, browser type, device used.
Location data: Geographic location (when permitted) to find nearby classes.
privacy.s3_intro: We do not sell your personal information to third parties. Information is only shared in the following cases:
s3_items: With tutors/students in the same class (name, necessary contact information).
When required by law enforcement agencies.
With service providers supporting platform operations.
privacy.s4_content: We apply advanced security measures including data encryption, two-factor authentication, and strict access control to protect your information.
s5_items: Access and view personal information provided.
Request account and related data deletion.
privacy.s6_content: We use cookies to improve browsing experience. You can disable cookies in browser settings, but this may affect some features.
privacy.s7_content: If you have questions about the privacy policy, please contact: privacy@edututor.vn

refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.s1_intro: Students may request refunds in the following cases:
s1_items: Tutor did not attend a scheduled session without prior notice.
Teaching quality did not match the class description.
Class was cancelled by the tutor or administrator.
Technical issues from the platform seriously affected the session.
s2_items: Refund requests must be submitted within 7 days of the incident.
After 7 days, requests will be reviewed on a case-by-case basis.
s3_items: Submit a refund request through the "Support" section on the platform.
Provide evidence (screenshots, detailed description).
Support team will review within 3–5 business days.
If approved, refund will be processed within 7–14 business days.
s4_items: Student voluntarily stopped attending without notice.
Student attended more than 50% of sessions.
Terms of service violation leading to account suspension.
refund.s5_content: Refunds will be processed via the original payment method or bank transfer according to the student's provided information.

dispute.title: Dispute Resolution
dispute.s1_content: EduTutor is committed to handling all disputes fairly, transparently and promptly. We encourage parties to resolve directly before escalating to the platform.
s2_items: Inappropriate behavior from tutors or students.
s3_items: Step 1: Submit a dispute report through the system with detailed description and evidence.
Step 2: Support team will contact both parties within 48 hours.
Step 3: Collect information and evidence from related parties.
Step 4: Make a resolution decision within 5–7 business days.
Step 5: Notify results and implement resolution measures.
s4_items: Partial or full refund to the student.
dispute.s5_content: If you disagree with the resolution decision, parties have the right to submit a second appeal within 7 days. The appeal will be reviewed by senior management.

antifraud.title: Anti-Fraud Policy
antifraud.s1_content: EduTutor is committed to building a safe, transparent environment. We apply multiple measures to detect and prevent fraudulent activities.
s2_items: Creating fake accounts for false reviews.
s3_items: Identity verification: Requiring tutors to provide student ID/ID card photos.
Reviews and feedback: Transparent review system from students.
Transaction monitoring: Tracking unusual transactions.
Reporting system: Allowing users to report suspicious behavior.
s4_items: Click the "Report" button on the profile page or in the conversation.
Describe the fraudulent behavior in detail.

community.title: Community Policy
community.s1_content: EduTutor builds a positive, respectful and supportive learning community. All members are responsible for maintaining a healthy environment.
s2_items: Cooperation: Support and encourage each other in learning.
Responsibility: Be accountable for your own behavior.
s3_items: Using vulgar, insulting, or threatening language.
Discrimination based on gender, religion, or ethnicity.
Harassing or bullying other members.
Posting inappropriate content (violence, pornography).
Spamming messages or unrelated advertising.
Sharing others' personal information without permission.
Using the platform for non-educational purposes.
s4_items: Serious violation: Permanent ban without warning.
s5_items: Give honest reviews after each course.
Report violations to protect the community.

tos_dialog.title: 📋 Terms of Service
tos_dialog.s1_content: Welcome to the Find Tutor platform. By using our services, you agree to comply with the terms and conditions outlined below. Please read carefully before using the service.
tos_dialog.s2_content:
"Platform" refers to the website and related services provided by Find Tutor.
"User" includes students, parents, and tutors using the platform.
"Tutor" is a person who registers to provide teaching services through the platform.
"Student" is a person who registers to find and use tutoring services.
tos_dialog.s3_content: You must be at least 13 years old to use the service. If under 18, you need the consent of a parent or legal guardian. You must provide accurate and up-to-date information when registering an account.
tos_dialog.s4_content: Each user is responsible for securing their login credentials. Do not share your account with others. All activities on the account are the responsibility of the account holder. The platform reserves the right to lock or delete accounts that violate the terms.
tos_dialog.s5_content: Tutors must provide truthful information about their education and teaching experience. Tutors commit to teaching according to the agreed schedule and content. The platform must not be used for fraud or advertising unrelated services. Tutors must follow the payment process through the platform.
tos_dialog.s6_content: Students must respect tutors and follow the registered schedule. Pay on time according to platform regulations. Do not use the platform to harass or send inappropriate content. Feedback and reviews must be honest and objective.
tos_dialog.s7_content: All payment transactions are processed through the platform. Service fees will be deducted at the published rate. Refunds only apply in specific regulated cases. The platform is not responsible for transactions outside the system.
tos_dialog.s8_content: Students are allowed to try classes within the specified trial period for each class. After the trial period ends, students need to officially register to continue. Benefits during the trial period may be limited compared to official registration.
tos_dialog.s9_content: We are committed to protecting users' personal information in accordance with the law. Personal information is only used for the purpose of providing services. Personal information will not be shared with third parties without user consent, except as required by law.
tos_dialog.s10_content: All content on the platform is owned by Find Tutor or the content creator. Do not copy or distribute content without permission. Teaching materials uploaded by tutors are owned by the respective tutor.
tos_dialog.s11_content: All forms of fraud, scams, and harassment on the platform are strictly prohibited. Do not post content that violates the law, ethics, or social norms. Do not use bots, scripts, or automated tools to interfere with the system. Violations may result in permanent account suspension.
tos_dialog.s12_content: The platform serves as an intermediary connecting tutors and students. We are not responsible for the quality of tutors' teaching. No specific learning outcomes are guaranteed. Disputes between tutors and students will be supported but the final decision rests with the parties involved.
tos_dialog.s13_content: We reserve the right to update the terms of service at any time. Users will be notified of important changes. Continuing to use the service after changes means accepting the new terms.
tos_dialog.s14_content: If you have any questions about the Terms of Service, please contact us through the Support function on the platform or via the email provided in the Contact section.
tos_dialog.agree_label: I have read and agree to the Terms of Service
